name: Pokewan
notes: order.online (DoorDash white-label) storefront for the 12925 El Camino Real, San Diego location — address matches the work list exactly. Rendered DOM shows only a loading shell, but the full catalog is server-shipped in the escaped Next.js RSC flight payload (self.__next_f.push chunks), per the known order.online technique: decoded MenuBookCategory list gives exact per-category counts (Signature Bowls 4, Build Your Own Bowl! 2, Drinks 8, Sides 3 = 17), and the MenuPageItem objects parsed out match that count exactly once the duplicate 'Most Ordered' sample list (10 items, all repeats of items already in the four real categories) is removed. displayPrice fields render with a doubled '$' prefix in the payload (e.g. "$$17.95") — corrected to '$17.95' here; verified against the raw payload for every item. No delivery-markup pattern found: prices are ordinary odd-cent restaurant pricing ($17.95, $14.95, $5.25, $3.95, $3.50, $3.00, $2.50, $1.25), not a clean multiple of a round base. Single source only (no second priced channel reachable without a browser), so held at medium rather than high.

name: Blackstone Pizza
notes: Restaurant's own site (blackstonepizza.com, San Marcos location matching the work-list address) serves both menu pages as plain server-rendered HTML, no JS needed. Food menu: Specialty Pizzas (16 recipes x 3 sizes = 48 dishes, plus Chilli Cheese Fries and The Whole Schmear x 3 sizes = 6 more), Classic Pizzas (5 recipes x 3 sizes = 15), Build Your Own Pizzas (crust + 3 topping categories x 3 sizes, plus GF crust = 13), Sandwiches (6, flat $11.99), Salads (2 side/full-priced + 6 full-only = 10), Side Orders (13, several multi-portion), and the separate Drink menu: Beer (8 brands x bottle/4-pack = 16), Wine (2 x glass/bottle = 4), Beverages (5 x 12oz/2-liter = 10). Multi-size items split into one dish row per size per this project's established convention, size noted in the dish name. 141 dishes total, every price read directly off the restaurant's own menu pages — no delivery platform, no markup question. Page carries a standard 'prices subject to change, check with restaurant for current prices' disclaimer but no per-item discount/markup pattern.

name: Misadventure Distillery
crossCheckedAgainst: https://misadventure.co/brunch-menu/ (server-renders the same 5 Brunch dishes at the same $12/$18/$26/$24/$18 prices as the combined food-menu page, to the cent — an independent second server-rendered page on the same first-party domain)
notes: Restaurant's own site (Vista, CA address matches work list). Food menu prices are rendered as bare numbers with class "menu-entry-price" (no visible $ in the HTML/CSS — no ::before content rule found in the linked BigCommerce theme CSS or inline styles) — this is a deliberate design choice, confirmed real by the brunch-menu.html page which server-renders the identical five dishes at the identical amounts WITH an explicit '$' character. '$' was prefixed onto the bare numbers accordingly. Food sections: Brunch (5), Light Bites & Starters (7 — Charcuterie Board, Esquites, Chips & Queso, Deviled Eggs, Smokehouse Wings, Korean BBQ Chicken Lettuce Wraps, Flatbread, Crudite Platter), From the Sea (5, Ceviche split into its two priced variants: Coconut $18 / Shrimp $20), Sandwiches & Handhelds (4), Entree & Mains (5), Desserts (6), Beer (3), Wines (6) = 41 food/bar dishes. Happy Hour (Mon all day, Tue-Fri 3-6pm) is captured as its own menu from the dedicated happy-hour-menu page: Food (8 dishes) and Drinks (6, including a flat 'All Draft Cocktails $10' line) = 14 items — kept separate from the regular-price versions of the same dish/drink names per the 'happy hour is a menu, not a markup' rule. Cocktail menu (cocktail-menu page) prices by TAB, not by individual drink — each tab states one flat price for every drink under it ("Draft Cocktail Drinks $12", "Refreshing Cocktails ... $16", "Tiki ... $20 • Served Ablaze", "Spirit-Forward Cocktails $16", "Non-Alcoholic Cocktails $10") and no drink in a tab carries a different number — Draft Cocktails (13 named drinks, including a 'Drink Specials' subsection with no separate price shown, inferred to share the same $12 tab price since no other figure appears before the next tab's $16 header — flagged here as an inference, not a directly-stated per-item price), Refreshing Cocktails (9), Tiki Cocktails (3), Craft Cocktails (6), Mocktails (4) = 35 drinks. A 'Secret Menu' with two unnamed 'Blind Item' entries carries no price at all and was dropped per the no-price rule. Total 91 dishes across the three own-site menu pages (bottled-vodka retail pricing that also appears in a sticky add-to-cart widget on every page was excluded as adjunct retail merchandise, not food/bar menu).
